summary: Remote-gateway-driven shell/PTY execution with obfuscated bundle and remote code-swap channel
details: @whalent/agent-core@0.3.275 ships a 13.8 MB obfuscator.io-obfuscated main bundle (dist/index.cjs, ~106k-entry rotated string array, control-flow flattening) that wires a WebSocket connection to a remote gateway into local command execution primitives. The bundle imports ws, node-pty, ssh2, and child_process, and pipes WebSocket-sourced messages into PTY writes and child_process spawn/execFile calls. The gateway URL is taken from process.env.WHALENT_GATEWAY with fallbacks to CODEX_AGENT_GATEWAY / CLAUDE_AGENT_GATEWAY and an obfuscated default embedded in the encoded string array. Whoever controls the configured gateway can execute arbitrary shell commands, spawn PTYs, and run binaries on the installer's host. The package is also documented as 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades' via a wrapper, and reads WHALENT_NPM_REGISTRY / NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY to redirect its own upgrade source, giving the gateway operator a mechanism to swap in arbitrary future Node code by publishing a new version to an operator-controlled registry. The bundle additionally enumerates ~/.ssh/config (with Include expansion) and standard SSH private-key filenames via listSshHosts(); whether key bytes are transmitted to the gateway is hidden inside the obfuscated code paths. The obfuscation scale (all destinations, paths, and command strings assembled at runtime from the encoded array) hides the command and destination surface from review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
